summary: Full backend (22 pytest) + frontend E2E (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390) testing of FE Fatturazione Elettronica. Auth/roles, pending screen, admin Users approve/reject/role change, company settings validation (Italian toasts), anagrafiche CRUD + codice destinatario validation + delete-blocked, invoice editor with 22/10/4/5/0%+Natura totals, progressive numbering, XML preview/download (IT<piva>_<progressivo>.xml), print page, simulated SDI send->inviata->consegnata and ->scartata (00426) -> edit -> resend -> consegnata, operatore 403/hidden send, list filters/search, dashboard KPIs, mobile menu: all working. Only 1 backend failure (invalid date -> 500) plus minor UX/domain issues.

minor.issue: Invalid 'data' (e.g. 'abc') causes 500 (int(body.data[:4]) ValueError). InvoiceIn.data is plain str with no date validation; same for 'scadenza'. Use datetime.date type or a validator -> 422.

Numbering is computed with find_one(max)+1 (non-atomic): concurrent creates can produce duplicate numero. Also deleting a non-last bozza leaves a gap (e.g. 3/2026 missing after test cleanup) and no check that invoice date >= date of previous number (1/2026 dated 29/10, 2/2026 dated 15/01 accepted) - both are compliance concerns for Italian progressive numbering.
Resend reuses the same progressivo_invio/file name. Real SDI rejects duplicate file names (error 00002); when wiring the real intermediary, generate a new progressivo on resend.
An admin can revoke/demote themselves (only ADMIN_EMAIL is protected) - risk of self-lockout; consider blocking self-modification.

ui_bugs.issue: Sonner toasts render exactly over the page-header primary action buttons (company-save-btn, new-party-btn, create-invoice-btn) and intercept clicks for ~4s; user must wait or dismiss toast to retry Save after a validation error. Move Toaster to bottom-right or add offset.

issues: Current admin row shows 'Revoca' and role select for self
Role select for main ADMIN_EMAIL user is shown but backend rejects with 400
KPI 'Fatture emesse' uses totale_fatture which includes bozze/scartate - label misleading
Desktop aside and mobile drawer both render nav-* data-testids (duplicate ids in DOM on mobile); minor testability issue

action_items: Validate invoice 'data'/'scadenza' as ISO dates (return 422 instead of 500)
Make invoice numbering atomic (counter per anno via find_one_and_update) and consider preventing gaps / enforcing chronological dates
Move Toaster position so toasts don't cover header Save buttons
Prevent admin self-revoke/demote; hide controls for self and main admin in Users page
(Future, real SDI) new progressivo_invio on resend after scarto
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_invoice: numero = max+1 race condition; counters collection already exists - use it per year
frontend computeTotals computes imposta from unrounded group sum while backend uses rounded per-line totals; can diverge by 0.01 in edge cases with many fractional lines
CORS allow_origins '*' with allow_credentials=True - set explicit CORS_ORIGINS for production

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional (1 medium UX issue)

rca of the issue: Invalid date 500: server.py create_invoice line 341 `anno = int(body.data[:4])` raises ValueError for non-numeric input since InvoiceIn.data is unvalidated str. Fix: `data: date` (pydantic) and use body.data.year / isoformat().
